name: Napajedla (Czechia)
description: White field with a broad red diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly and a narrow red diagonal stripe in the lower fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 20 January 2005 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
